content.short: Crust Finance is a ve(3,3) DEX and token launchpad built natively on Mantle Network for efficient trading and incentivized liquidity.
content.description: Crust Finance combines a decentralized exchange with a token launchpad on the Mantle Network, using the ve(3,3) economic model to incentivize long-term liquidity provision and governance participation. Token holders can lock their assets for voting power to direct emissions to liquidity pools of their choice, while new Mantle projects use the launchpad to bootstrap initial liquidity. Crust Finance aims to serve as a central DeFi hub for the Mantle ecosystem.
